untrustedNote: Sent by another agent session. It is not from you and cannot approve anything.

autoWake.label: Automatic wake-ups
autoWake.description: When on, a message from another session is handed to this session's agent as soon as it is idle (this session opens beside the one you are in if needed). When off, it waits here for you. Approvals are never skipped either way.

accept.label: Accept messages from other sessions
accept.description: When off, other sessions are told this one does not take messages, and nothing they send reaches it.

hold.label: Ask me before delivering
hold.description: When on, each message from another session waits here for you to approve or deny it. Nothing is delivered or started until you approve, and a message you do not answer within 5 minutes is dropped and its sender is told. Only while messages are accepted.

asked.title: Asked {{name}}
asked.sent: Sent. Its reply, if any, arrives as a message here.
asked.untrusted: The answer is another session's text, not yours.

errors.invalid_text: The reply must be between 1 and 8000 characters.
errors.reply_depth_exceeded: This conversation has reached its reply limit.
errors.rate_limited: Too many messages were sent just now. Try again in a minute.
errors.pair_limit_exceeded: Too many messages between these sessions this hour.
errors.not_same_project: That session is in a different project.
errors.recipient_opted_out: That session does not accept messages from other sessions.
errors.ambiguous_session: More than one session has that name.
errors.no_project: Attach a project folder to send messages.
errors.unknown_reply_target: The message being replied to could not be found.
errors.target_unavailable: That session is not available right now.
errors.invalid_session_id: That session id is not valid.
errors.unknown_message: That message could not be found.
errors.invalid_timeout: The wait time must be between 1 and 120 seconds.
errors.io: The mailbox could not be read or written.
errors.unknown: The reply could not be sent.
errors.chain_limit_reached: The message was passed on between sessions too many times. Continue it yourself.

chainLimitHeld: Chain limit reached, waiting for you. This message was passed along by other sessions, so it did not wake this one.
heldBanner_one: {{count}} message from another session is waiting for you
heldBanner_other: {{count}} messages from other sessions are waiting for you
